release_gate.meaning: Hard deployment gate. PRODUCTION requires engineering quality, verified historical entry timing, dynamic advanced data, multi-book pricing, robust historical edge and portfolio-verified independent live evidence; it is not a guarantee of future profit.
next_requirements: Regenerate historical evidence with explicit archived opening-entry provenance; archive-final fallbacks cannot promote the system.
Keep paper testing until verified-entry walk-forward ROI confidence clears zero with positive CLV across markets and seasons.
Accumulate portfolio-verified graded live/shadow decisions and pre-kickoff line snapshots; do not infer live profitability from historical backtests.
